text: S9: packaging, README, dev server, full-system test

The full-system test surfaced a real bug beyond this ticket's own scope:
gc.run() (T-8) didn't account for invites.list_id's own FK to lists(id).
Purging an orphaned list that ever had an invite minted for it (used, revoked,
or expired - doesn't matter, the row just has to still exist) raised a FK
IntegrityError. T-6/T-8's dedicated orphan-purge regression test never minted
an invite for the list it tested, so it missed this entirely. Fixed in gc.py:
list purge now deletes items + memberships + invites (all three FKs) before
the list row. Added a direct regression test in test_gc.py.
